brief: The clerk. Mute. Files your entries into the ledgers and never speaks. Ink-stained cuffs, a vest, spectacles. Must read as a records-keeper, not a shopkeeper. Same 16x32 cells and sheet layout as the player, a touch narrower in the shoulders.
sketchNote: Same 16x32 cell and sheet layout as the player. Flat hair, spectacles (the = frames around each eye on row 8), a dark vest open over a light shirt, light sleeves with dark ink-stained cuffs on row 18. Two pixels narrower than the mayor through the body.
